# Narayana Coaching Centers

> India's leading IIT-JEE and NEET coaching institution with 45+ years of expertise, offering comprehensive preparation programs across 20+ centers nationwide.

Narayana Coaching Centers is a premier educational institution specializing in competitive exam preparation for engineering and medical entrance tests. The organization operates multiple centers across India and provides diverse learning modalities including classroom programs, test series, foundation courses, and scholarship opportunities.

## Key Topics

- IIT-JEE Coaching
- NEET Coaching
- Competitive Exam Preparation
- Test Series (NAITS)
- Scholarship Test (NACST)
- Foundation Courses
- Repeater Programs
- Olympiad Coaching
- Classroom Programs
- Engineering Entrance Exams
- Medical Entrance Exams
- Expert Mentoring
- National Benchmarking
- Personalized Strategies
- IITs & NITs

## Core Programs

- [Best IIT-JEE & NEET Coaching in India | Narayana Coaching Centers](https://narayanacoachingcenters.in): Homepage showcasing Narayana's IIT-JEE & NEET coaching with 45+ years expertise
- [NAITS - All India Test Series for IIT-JEE & NEET](https://www.narayanacoachingcenters.in/naits): NAITS all-india test series with national benchmarking and performance tracking
- [Narayana Admission Cum Scholarship Test (NACST) 2025-26](https://www.narayanacoachingcenters.in/NACST): NACST scholarship test for JEE & NEET aspirants with exam details and registration
- [Best IIT-JEE Repeater Course | Narayana Coaching Centers](https://narayanacoachingcenters.in/iit-jee-repeater): IIT-JEE repeater course with targeted preparation and advanced test strategies
- [Best NEET Repeater Course | Narayana Coaching Centers](https://narayanacoachingcenters.in/neet-repeater): NEET repeater course with expert guidance, mock tests and personalized strategies
